admin.title: Homepage image
admin.help: Replaces the welcome banner with an image of the same size and a light dark overlay.
admin.profile_help: Let groups change their own profile cover from the Permissions tab. Uploaded images are re-encoded on the server.
admin.upload_help: PNG, JPG, GIF, or WEBP. Max 3 MB. A wide landscape image works best.
admin.overlay_help: Higher values make the image darker.
